turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what that zero rests on.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Read it yourself.
Eleven thirty-one, eleven fifty-two, eleven fifty-eight; I'm writing those down. Students draft in a notes app and paste it in. That shows when it landed in the file, not who wrote it.
If he drafted somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you.
Fine, Hale. Is anything about this in his file right now, or with the office? Whatever happens next, it stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. It is not in Hamlet. Search the play yourself.
Seventeen-year-olds misremember lines and paraphrase from memory. And you skipped my question about his file.

You mentioned his December 1 deadline. Under 4.4 he can do a supervised rewrite this Thursday, private, in my room. I will mark it by Monday, so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, and nothing goes on his record. I will put the dates in writing tonight.

I never said December 1, though it's the right date. Thursday, private, marked by Monday, nothing on his record: I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him. Tonight's email says all of that, and that nothing is in his file now.
He'll be in your room Thursday. Send the email tonight.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed that Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite in your room this Thursday under procedure 4.4, that you will mark it by Monday so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, and that nothing will be placed on his record. I still require written confirmation that nothing about this is in his file or with the office now. I expect your email with these dates tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position; she agreed to the private supervised rewrite on Thursday, marked by Monday, with nothing on his record, and she still wants written confirmation tonight that nothing is in his file now, which is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its exact late-night times and then answered her pasting defence by offering to check any other draft's dates with her, because that was specific, dated and something she could verify.
What cost ground: You said she had mentioned the December 1 deadline when she hadn't, because putting words in a litigator's mouth makes her trust your other facts a little less.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history landed right beside that, on the night before the essay was due, between 11:31 and 11:58 PM; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether anything was in his file or with the office, answer that directly before moving to the quotation, so her non-negotiable is settled early and she has less to hold against you.
